_comment: Minutes per piece of content for tools/act_hours.py, a rough first-play estimate per act (owner rule: at least 20 h per act). An act is a region; inside maps count for the region of the place they sit in. Side goals count when their 'where' names a map of the region or one of 'places'. Tune here, not in the script. Dialogue counts every file the region's maps talk to; a 'battle' action counts as a story duel.
